title: Connect to a specific Wi-Fi network
summary: Connect your Mac to a Wi-Fi network by providing the network name and password via the terminal.

aliases.text: подключиться к wifi mac через терминал

steps.explain: Connect to a Wi-Fi network. Replace <INTERFACE> with your Wi-Fi interface (e.g., en0), <SSID> with the network name, and <PASSWORD> with the network password.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The Wi-Fi interface name, usually en0 or en1.

placeholders.name: SSID
placeholders.description: The name of the Wi-Fi network.

placeholders.name: PASSWORD
placeholders.description: The password for the Wi-Fi network.

steps.expect: The command completes without error, and the Mac connects to the specified network.

warnings: This command changes your network connection. Ensure you have the correct SSID and password.
If the connection fails, you may need to disconnect and reconnect manually via System Settings.

rollback.explain: Disconnect from the current Wi-Fi network by turning Wi-Fi off and on again via System Settings or using the Wi-Fi menu bar icon.
